description: This source file defines the class BuzzLikeOnShareDecorator, which serves as a decorator for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity. It provides methods to set related entities such as Employee and BuzzShare by their identifiers, and to retrieve formatted date and time information about when a like was made on a share. The class utilizes traits for ORM entity management and date/time formatting.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional behavior and formatting for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity, including setting related entities and formatting timestamp information.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Returns the BuzzLikeOnShare entity instance associated with this decorator.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the like, identified by employee number.

methods.name: setShareByShareId
methods.description: Sets the BuzzShare associated with the like, identified by share ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the like was made, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Retrieves the time when the like was made, formatted as a string.
